blocks.title: ChampionMod
blocks.tagline: Adds Warrior and Champion medals above the author medal on the official tracks of TrackMania United Forever.

items.title: Two new medals
items.text: Warrior and Champion medals above the author medal.

items.title: Game files untouched
items.text: Writes nothing to the game files.

blocks.title: Install
blocks.markdown: Install the TrackMania ModLoader, then copy the `ChampionMod` folder to `%LocalAppData%\TMLoader\database\TmForever\products`.
